name: Kolam / Sona Loops
desc: A symmetric South-Indian kolam that threads smooth continuous chalk loops around a glowing grid of pulli dots, drawing itself outward from the centre and re-blooming into a fresh endless-knot pattern every few bars.

density.doc: grid resolution — how many pulli/loops across the frame

energy.doc: glow / chalk-bloom amplitude and stroke weight

scale.doc: loop tile size (higher = bigger loops, fewer)
